credit: Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2026 (S2B_48MVA_20260426_0_L2A); river line and basin name (c) OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL, via Overture
method: MNDWI (green B03, SWIR B11 at 10 m) > 0.1 and turbid (red B04 > 0.095, or MNDWI > 0.6) for the river, which drops the clear-water flooded fields beside it (one pixel of bank given back), and > 0.0 for basin/canal, connected to the mapped Komering line, 2-px closing, islands < 1 ha filled, vectorised, simplify 4 m + 5 m round open/close. Water surface on 26 Apr 2026, not a survey; outline within about 10 m of the pixels.
